papers.title: Training-Free Active Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Test-time adaptation (TTA) for vision-language models (VLMs) is usually studied in a fully unsupervised regime, where adaptation relies on pseudo-labels, confidence scores, or entropy computed by the model itself. This is a severe restriction on hard shifted samples: the model is asked to repair its own uncertain predictions without any external evidence. At the other extreme, supervised online adaptation assumes labels can directly train or correct the model. We study the intermediate deployment regime between these two extremes. In Active Test-time Adaptation for VLMs (Active VLM-TTA), a pretrained VLM may spend an explicit labeling budget on selected test samples, but the prediction for the current sample must be emitted before its label can be used; queried labels are therefore costed, delayed evidence for future samples rather than free correction for the present one. Under this future-only constraint, the central question is how to reuse sparse labels conservatively. We instantiate this setting with ACTive VLM-TTA for Online Retrieval (ACTOR), a training-free plug-in module that routes uncertain samples among base prediction, label query, and memory-based correction using a consistency-and-reliability check over previously queried labels. Across ten cross-domain benchmarks and a domain-transfer benchmark based on ImageNet, ACTOR consistently improves strong VLM-TTA baselines on ResNet and ViT backbones with negligible inference overhead. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/kaist-dmlab/ACTOR.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种无需训练的主动测试时适应设置：VLM可在测试样本上使用有限标注预算，但当前样本必须在获取标签前给出预测，查询得到的标签只能惠及后续样本。
summary.methods: 设计ACTOR插件模块，利用对已查询标签的一致性与可靠性检查，在基础预测、标签查询和基于记忆的修正之间路由不确定样本；在十个跨域基准及一个基于ImageNet的域迁移基准上评估，覆盖ResNet和ViT骨干。
summary.relevance: 直接对应持续适应与预训练、多模态学习主题，研究预训练视觉语言模型在分布偏移下的在线适配与标签高效利用。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体精度提升数值；标签预算大小、查询策略的开销细节及失败情形未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: ROSE: Risk-Aware Orthogonal Subspace Navigation for Lifelong Knowledge Editing in Multimodal Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) require continuous factual updates to stay current, yet lifelong knowledge editing remains a daunting challenge. The primary obstacle is the severe Locality Erosion and Catastrophic Forgetting, where sequential edits inevitably interfere with pre-trained capabilities and prior updates. In this paper, we propose \textbf{ROSE}, a \textbf{R}isk-aware \textbf{O}rthogonal \textbf{S}ubspace navigation framework for lifelong knowledge \textbf{E}diting. ROSE addresses forgetting by aiming to restrict parameter updates to the orthogonal complement of previously edited subspaces. Crucially, it introduces a risk-guided mechanism that utilizes a dynamically computed risk mask to safeguard specific factual parameter subspaces essential for model stability. During inference, ROSE employs a multi-granularity knowledge integration strategy, featuring prototype-anchored semantic gating and perturbation-driven subspace fusion to precisely activate edited knowledge for relevant queries while limiting interference on unrelated inputs. Comprehensive experiments on two prominent multimodal benchmarks show that ROSE is competitive with state-of-the-art approaches across five key metrics, while maintaining outstanding stability over $1,000$ sequential updates. Our code is available at https://github.com/sunlitsong/ROSE.

summary.takeaway: 提出ROSE框架，用于多模态大语言模型的终身知识编辑，旨在缓解顺序编辑导致的局部性侵蚀和灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 将参数更新限制在既往编辑子空间的正交补中，引入动态风险掩码保护关键事实参数子空间；推理时采用原型锚定语义门控和扰动驱动子空间融合的多粒度知识整合策略。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、持续学习与多模态学习主题，关注多模态模型的事实更新与稳定性。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在五项指标上与最先进方法具有竞争力，未给出具体数值；风险掩码的计算成本与超参数敏感性未说明。

papers.title: GeoJeV: Unified Spatial Probability for Training-Free Efficient Evidence Acquisition in Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
papers.abstract: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing imagery provides rich spatial details but poses challenges for accurate and efficient multimodal understanding. Existing evidence acquisition methods selectively explore relevant image regions, yet largely rely on generative multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for intermediate search control. However, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) primarily aligns these models with human-preferred responses rather than explicitly optimizing region-level relevance judgments, while repeated autoregressive decoding introduces additional computational overhead. To address these limitations, we propose GeoJeV, a training-free method that formulates evidence acquisition as spatial probability-driven decision making. At each evaluated region, a frozen JeV model produces a probability distribution over candidate regions. Specifically, Region Rank prioritizes candidate regions, Sparse Branch adaptively determines branching width through sparse probability support, and Depth Gate controls refinement depth based on branch sparsity and distribution concentration. By coordinating search priority, branching width, and refinement depth through a shared distribution, GeoJeV reduces reliance on RLHF-aligned generation and eliminates intermediate decoding. Experiments on LRS-GRO, MME-RealWorld-RS, and LRS-VQA achieve accuracies of 60.59%, 52.79%, and 34.32%, respectively. Across the three benchmarks, GeoJeV improves the average accuracy of Qwen3-VL-8B by +5.32pp with only 1.12 additional seconds per question, while achieving a 7.8-fold inference speedup over the recent method.

summary.takeaway: 提出GeoJeV，将超高分辨率遥感图像的证据获取表述为空间概率驱动的决策，避免依赖RLHF对齐的生成式搜索控制与中间自回归解码。
summary.methods: 使用冻结的JeV模型对候选区域输出概率分布，通过Region Rank、Sparse Branch和Depth Gate协同控制搜索优先级、分支宽度与细化深度；在LRS-GRO、MME-RealWorld-RS和LRS-VQA上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应检索增强与对齐、多模态学习及高效推理主题，关注多模态模型在遥感场景中的证据获取效率。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的准确率为基准特定数值，未提供与所有对比方法的完整差异分析；方法对JeV模型概率校准质量的依赖程度未讨论。

papers.title: Decoupled Mode Connectivity for Base-to-Novel Generalization in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Prompt learning adapts vision-language models such as CLIP by optimizing a short learnable prompt. The cross-entropy objective pulls this prompt toward base-class specialization, whereas generalization to unseen classes benefits from staying close to CLIP's zero-shot feature space. Because both objectives act on the same prompt, their gradients conflict at convergence, and in our experiments no single-prompt loss design clearly improves on the cosine baseline. We propose Decoupled Mode Connectivity (DMC), which gives each objective its own prompt. Starting from a base-trained prompt, DMC trains a specialization prompt and a generalization prompt, and merges their text features with a fixed coefficient at test time, at the inference cost of a single prompt. A linear mode connectivity (LMC) corridor in text-feature space keeps the classification loss low for every classifier interpolated between the two endpoints, and a Visual Anchor KL term preserves CLIP's zero-shot class-similarity distribution of each image during specialization. We further argue that such regularizers should satisfy class-permutation invariance (CPI), and show via Fano's inequality, in an idealized model, that violating CPI lower-bounds the drop in novel accuracy by a term proportional to the mutual information between the prompt and the base-class labels. Across 11 datasets, DMC improves the average harmonic mean of base and novel accuracy over MergeTune for both CoOp and KgCoOp, and its interpolation curves pass beyond the single-prompt operating point, shifting the base-novel frontier rather than trading along it. Code is available at https://github.com/IemProg/DMC.

summary.takeaway: 提出解耦模式连通性DMC，用两个独立提示分别承担基类专业化与新颖类泛化，以缓解同一提示上梯度冲突的问题。
summary.methods: 从基类训练提示出发，分别训练专业化提示和泛化提示，测试时以固定系数合并文本特征；采用文本特征空间的线性模式连通性走廊和视觉锚KL正则，并从理论上讨论类置换不变性。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解主题，研究CLIP类视觉语言模型从基类到新颖类的泛化。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在11个数据集上相对MergeTune提升调和平均，但未给出具体数值；理论分析基于理想化模型，实际适用边界需进一步验证。

papers.title: Did I See It or Think It? Probing Reality Monitoring in Vision-Language Models with Concept Injection
papers.abstract: Recent work tests whether language models can introspect by injecting a concept direction into their activations and asking whether they notice it and can name it. These studies are text-only. Vision-language models (VLMs) face an additional problem, known in cognitive psychology as reality monitoring: they must keep internally generated content separate from what they actually see. We therefore ask: can VLMs distinguish injected concepts from image content? We introduce a paradigm that varies the image and the injected concept independently. On each trial, the model reports what it sees, whether a thought was injected, and what that thought is. This design scores both whether the model identifies the concept and which source it assigns to it. Across six VLMs, only Gemma-3-27B reliably identifies injected concepts (35% vs. 3% for steering alone), with almost no false alarms. Even then, the source it reports is fragile. Strong or visual-pathway injections are reported as seen, and a visible object nearly eliminates correct thought reports. The same failure appears in ordinary captioning, where injected objects appear in up to 87% of captions of real photographs. Evaluating multimodal self-reports therefore requires checking both their content and their reported source.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种独立变化图像与注入概念的实验范式，检验视觉语言模型能否区分内部注入内容与真实所见，即现实监测能力。
summary.methods: 在每次试验中要求模型报告所见内容、是否被注入想法以及该想法是什么，同时对内容识别和来源归属评分；在六个VLM上进行概念注入实验，并观察普通描述任务中的类似失败。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态学习与跨模态理解主题，涉及VLM内部表征、自我报告可靠性与多模态对齐评估。
summary.caveat: 摘要显示仅Gemma-3-27B能较可靠识别注入概念，且来源报告脆弱；结论受模型规模和注入强度影响，摘要未提供完整统计细节。

papers.title: StreamTab: Training-Free Temporal Link Prediction with Tabular Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Temporal link prediction uses past interactions to predict whether two nodes will interact in the future. Temporal graph neural networks achieve strong results on this task, but they are trained separately for each graph. How a model should use interaction history also depends on the candidates it is compared with. A past interaction can distinguish a recurring link from a random pair that has never interacted, but when the negative candidates have also interacted before, other signals are needed. We propose StreamTab, a training-free framework built on a frozen tabular foundation model pretrained only on synthetic tables. StreamTab describes each candidate pair by statistics of its past interactions and shows the model recent observed interactions and sampled negative pairs as labeled examples, from which the model scores new candidates. Its central design, regime conditioning, samples the negative examples according to how the candidates are sampled, so the examples show the distinction the model must make. As new interactions arrive, StreamTab updates the statistics and refreshes the examples while the model parameters stay fixed. On thirteen datasets against 21 temporal graph baselines, StreamTab achieves the highest average precision on twelve datasets under historical sampling and eleven under inductive sampling, and ranks first or stays within one point of the best on seven datasets under random sampling. With the same features and model, regime conditioning raises average precision over examples with random negatives by a median of 12.6 points under historical sampling.

summary.takeaway: 提出StreamTab，一种基于冻结表格基础模型的无训练时序链接预测框架，通过按候选采样方式选取负例的机制条件化提升判别能力。
summary.methods: 用候选对过去交互的统计量描述样本，将近期观测交互和采样负例作为带标签示例输入冻结的表格基础模型进行打分；随新交互到达更新统计与示例，模型参数保持不变；在13个数据集上与21个时序图基线比较。
summary.relevance: 对应图谱构建与表示、预训练及检索增强主题，关注时序图上的链接预测与基础模型复用。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在历史采样和归纳采样下的最优数据集数量，但未列出全部指标数值；方法依赖手工统计特征的质量，长程依赖建模能力未讨论。

papers.title: Typed-Centrality Grounding for Agentic GraphRAG: A Symbolic Approach for Agentic Reasoning
papers.abstract: Knowledge Graphs (KGs) and Large Language Models (LLMs) represent two approaches for knowledge representation and reasoning over heterogeneous data. Recent research has explored their integration through Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) systems, which use KGs to provide structured context to LLMs. However, existing GraphRAG approaches treat KGs as homogeneous graphs and rely on textual similarity between the input prompt and the context, rather than using it as a source of deterministic knowledge. This work proposes an agent-based GraphRAG system that introduces a symbolic layer to integrate deterministic reasoning alongside text similarities. This approach is based on the definition of typed centralities for KGs, where centrality measures are computed separately for each specific KG's class. This information is used to construct a symbolic representation that is provided to the LLM as a deterministic source. The proposed system was mathematically validated and evaluated on a real-world POLE (Person, Object, Location, Event) dataset, comparing reasoning and information retrieval with and without the symbolic layer. The results indicate that the our approach leads to responses that are more consistent with the context, improving the generated outputs.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种面向智能体GraphRAG的类型化中心性接地方法，在文本相似度之外引入符号层，为LLM提供确定性知识表示。
summary.methods: 为知识图谱中每个类别分别计算类型化中心性度量，据此构造符号表示并作为确定性来源提供给LLM；在真实POLE数据集上比较有无符号层的推理与信息检索效果，并进行数学验证。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及知识图谱主题，研究GraphRAG中结构化知识与LLM推理的结合。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称生成输出与上下文更一致，未给出量化指标；符号层的构建成本、对图谱类别定义质量的敏感性未说明。

papers.title: Grounding-Aware Judge Reward Reinforcement Learning for Out-of-Domain Face Anti-Spoofing
papers.abstract: Face Anti-Spoofing (FAS) must distinguish genuine faces from presentation attacks. A unified Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) is an attractive solution: it detects physical attacks (print, replay, mask) in one model and produces interpretable forensic evidence via Chain-of-Thought (CoT). A central obstacle to post-training such a model with reinforcement learning is that FAS reasoning has no rule-verifiable ground truth: only the binary verdict is checkable, while the reasoning chain cannot be verified by any hand-crafted rule. Optimizing the verdict alone is therefore a sparse, hackable signal. The model can reach the correct answer through a shortcut such as a false-rejection bias, which does not generalize. We address this with a grounding-aware judge reward. A 32B vision-language judge scores each reasoning chain against the image on evidence anchoring, logical coherence, and domain knowledge, turning the image itself into the verification signal. The reward is applied in a Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stage after CoT supervised fine-tuning. It is the judge, rather than the RL objective, that supplies the process supervision a verdict-only reward cannot. Our study starts from a model that already performs well In-Domain (ID) after CoT-based supervised fine-tuning and asks how to improve its Out-of-Domain (OOD) generalization. We find that grounding-aware rewards are an effective means to that end. We validate the method on OOD generalization, where the reward reduces ACER on two physical benchmarks (LCC-FASD 0.288 to 0.273, MSU-MFSD 0.431 to 0.409) while preserving ID accuracy (CelebA-Spoof 0.033 to 0.035). Against ResNet-50/101 and CLIP-ViT-B/16 baselines, the MLLM dominates ID and matches or surpasses the strongest baseline OOD. To our knowledge this is the first use of LLM-as-judge process supervision for FAS.

summary.takeaway: 提出接地感知的评判奖励强化学习，用视觉语言评判模型依据图像对思维链进行过程监督，以改善人脸反欺骗模型的域外泛化。
summary.methods: 在思维链监督微调后采用GRPO阶段，由32B视觉语言评判模型从证据锚定、逻辑连贯性和领域知识三个维度打分；在LCC-FASD、MSU-MFSD和CelebA-Spoof上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、强化学习与多模态学习主题，涉及LLM作为评判者的过程监督及多模态安全应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告ACER的小幅下降和ID准确率基本保持，提升幅度有限；评判模型自身偏差对奖励可靠性的影响未讨论。

papers.title: CARGO: Causal Attribution and Responsibility-Guided Preventive Safe Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Cooperative Driving
papers.abstract: This study presents Causal Attribution and Responsibility-Guided Optimization (CARGO), a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for cooperative on-ramp merging in mixed traffic. A shared latent-context posterior and an action-conditioned response model estimate directed behavioral influence, with posterior uncertainty propagated into interaction-edge selection. Complementary attribution mechanisms couple signed influence with marginal team utility for cooperative reward shaping and assign responsibility from positive excess tail risk relative to a safe reference policy. Conditional diffusion generates future responses for action-dependent risk estimation. Responsibility-guided preventive optimization calibrates agent-specific risk-reduction requirements to local capacity within a policy trust region, using reserved safety margins, adaptive requirement scaling, and joint feasibility verification. Theoretical analysis establishes risk monotonicity and sufficient local conditions for non-decreasing environmental return under explicit assumptions. Experiments in highway-env across three traffic densities, together with controlled graph-recovery and attribution studies, support the effectiveness of the framework. Under high-density traffic, CARGO increases the success rate by 66.04\% and reduces the crash rate by 56.23\% relative to the best evaluated baseline for each metric.

summary.takeaway: 提出CARGO框架，将因果归因与责任引导的风险优化结合，用于混合交通协同匝道汇入的多智能体强化学习，在高密度交通下相对最佳基线提升成功率并降低碰撞率。
summary.methods: 采用共享潜在上下文后验与动作条件响应模型估计有向行为影响，将后验不确定性传播到交互边选择；结合符号影响与边际团队效用做奖励塑形，按相对安全参考策略的正超额尾部风险分配责任；用条件扩散模型生成未来响应以评估动作相关风险，并在策略信任域内进行责任引导的预防性优化；在highway-env三种交通密度下实验，并做图恢复与归因的受控研究。
summary.relevance: 直接对应强化学习与多智能体奖励学习主题，涉及因果归因、奖励塑形与安全约束的多智能体协同驾驶。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的性能提升数字（成功率+66.04%、碰撞率-56.23%）来自特定基线与实验设置，理论保证依赖明确假设，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Differentially Private GraphRAG: Protecting Relation Connectivity and Semantics
papers.abstract: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) connects information across documents through entity relationships to support relational reasoning. However, black-box access to GraphRAG systems can enable adversaries to reconstruct knowledge graphs and recover both structural connectivity between entities and the semantics of their relationships. Existing defenses lack formal privacy guarantees and provide limited protection against such reconstruction attacks. We propose RelGuard, the first differentially private framework for GraphRAG, which provides formal privacy guarantees by mitigating connectivity leakage and protecting relations and their semantic meaning through relation removal. We formalize relation differential privacy (relation-DP), which bounds the distinguishability of mechanism outputs according to the semantic distance between alternative relations while accounting for relation removal. Building on this definition, we develop a four-step defense mechanism that sanitizes source documents before GraphRAG indexing by perturbing relation predicates or removing their associated connectivity using the exponential mechanism. Experiments across three GraphRAG systems and two targeted reconstruction attacks demonstrate that RelGuard provides stronger protection against reconstruction attacks than four existing defense mechanisms while better preserving downstream utility.

summary.takeaway: 提出RelGuard，首个为GraphRAG提供形式化隐私保证的差分隐私框架，通过移除或扰动关系来缓解知识图谱连接性与语义的重建泄漏。
summary.methods: 形式化关系差分隐私（relation-DP），按备选关系间的语义距离界定输出不可区分性并考虑关系移除；在GraphRAG索引前对源文档做四步净化，用指数机制扰动关系谓词或移除关联连接；在三种GraphRAG系统与两种针对性重建攻击上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应检索增强与知识图谱主题，关注GraphRAG系统的隐私保护与下游效用平衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要只说明保护更强且下游效用更好，未给出具体量化结果与隐私预算设置细节。

papers.title: Assessing the Impact of Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Algorithmic Problem-Solving
papers.abstract: Competitive programming problems pose distinctive challenges for Large Language Models, as they demand not only proficient code generation but also advanced algorithmic reasoning. This study presents a Retrieval-Augmented Generation approach specifically designed to enhance the capacity of Large Language Models to address such problems. Our approach integrates an embedding-based retrieval mechanism and a similarity search algorithm to identify analogous problems within a knowledge database, employing a dynamically adjusted threshold to mitigate retrieval noise. We conducted an evaluation using the CodeContests dataset, focusing on the test split problems that exhibit similarity to instances from the training split. The experimental framework considered three conditions: (i) problems provided solely with their original descriptions, (ii) problems supplemented with randomly selected examples from the training split, and (iii) problems augmented with similar examples retrieved through the proposed method. In addition, we incorporated a Min-K membership inference analysis to examine whether the generated code solutions were influenced by potential memorization of training data within the evaluated Large Language Models. This complementary perspective enables a deeper understanding of model behavior by distinguishing genuine generalization through retrieval from implicit recall of pretraining samples. Performance was assessed using both pass rates and the CodeForces Elo rating of the problems. The results provide empirical evidence that similarity-based retrieval substantially enhances Large Language Models performance in competitive programming scenarios, offering an scalable framework for improving code generation in algorithmic problem-solving contexts.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向竞赛编程的检索增强生成方法，用相似题目检索提升大语言模型的算法问题求解表现，并用成员推断分析区分检索泛化与预训练记忆。
summary.methods: 结合基于嵌入的检索与相似度搜索，用动态调整阈值减少检索噪声；在CodeContests数据集上比较三种条件（原始描述、随机训练样例、检索相似样例），并做Min-K成员推断分析；以通过率和CodeForces Elo评估。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型、检索增强与对齐及预训练主题，考察RAG对算法推理能力的影响。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体性能数值，成员推断分析只能提供间接证据，结论受数据集与检索库构造方式影响。

papers.title: ZeoBench: A Benchmark for Self-Supervised Learning on 3D Zeolite Representations
papers.abstract: Zeolites are an important class of porous crystalline materials with broad applications in gas storage, separations, and catalysis. Although hundreds of thousands of experimentally realized and hypothetical zeolite structures are known, identifying materials optimized for a target application remains challenging because property labels are expensive to obtain and available only for limited structure-molecule pairs. While prior work has demonstrated that 3D neural representations can predict zeolite properties effectively, it remains unclear which representation-learning strategies are most effective in the low-data regime relevant to materials discovery. We present ZeoBench, a benchmark for self-supervised learning on dense 3D representations of all-silica zeolites, and evaluate the resulting features on six existing downstream adsorption-property prediction tasks, across a range of training set sizes. Our study compares self-supervised 3D pretraining on volumetric zeolite data, adaptations of image-pretrained 2D ConvNets and vision transformers to 3D via multiview and channel-inflation strategies, and 3D ConvNets pretrained on out-of-domain volumetric datasets, alongside hand-crafted descriptors and supervised baselines. Using our pretraining and evaluation framework, we find self-supervised 3D representations outperform existing methods and achieve state-of-the-art performance across both in-domain label regimes and for the unseen domain of metal organic frameworks. Learned representations consistently outperform hand-crafted descriptors, and convolutional architectures are generally more effective than vision transformers in this setting. These results establish ZeoBench as a practical benchmark for 3D representation learning in zeolites and provide guidance for data-limited adsorption property prediction.

summary.takeaway: 提出ZeoBench，用于全硅沸石稠密3D表示的自监督学习基准，发现自监督3D表示在低数据吸附性质预测上优于现有方法。
summary.methods: 在体积沸石数据上做自监督3D预训练，并与经多视图和通道膨胀适配到3D的图像预训练2D CNN与ViT、域外体积数据预训练的3D CNN、手工描述符及监督基线比较；在六个吸附性质预测任务和不同训练集规模上评估，并测试到金属有机框架的域外迁移。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与自监督表示学习主题，也涉及检索增强与对齐中的表示评估思路。
summary.caveat: 摘要称达到最优但未给出具体指标数值，结论主要限于全硅沸石与所评估的吸附任务。

papers.title: scDisentangle: sequential disentanglement for single-cell perturbation response prediction
papers.abstract: Predicting the transcriptional response of single cells to perturbation is a central goal of single-cell modeling, with broad application to analysis and experimental design. Existing methods often fail to beat simple baselines and offer little insight into how biological variation is organized. We present scDisentangle, a model that decomposes single-cell expression into observed attributes and a sequence of residual components, generating counterfactuals that preserve source cell identity. scDisentangle outperformed current models and naive baselines on cytokine stimulation, liver infection, and unseen combinatorial genetic perturbations, on which accuracy was largely independent of how closely a response resembled the average perturbation effect. In an immune checkpoint inhibitor-associated myocarditis cohort, cell-resolved counterfactuals predicted donor-specific intracardiac CD8+ T cell states from peripheral blood. In a castration-regeneration prostate atlas, predictions recapitulated luminal dynamics and progenitor-marker kinetics upon androgen add-back. scDisentangle's coarse-to-fine latent structure aligned with hematopoietic lineage organization, with early levels capturing a less differentiated core progressively refined into cell-type-specific programs.

summary.takeaway: 提出scDisentangle，将单细胞表达分解为观测属性与一系列残差成分，生成保留源细胞身份的反事实扰动响应预测。
summary.methods: 采用由粗到细的序列解耦潜在结构，在细胞因子刺激、肝脏感染和未见组合遗传扰动上评估；在免疫检查点抑制剂相关心肌炎队列与去势-再生前列腺图谱中做细胞级反事实预测。
summary.relevance: 直接对应单细胞扰动主题，涉及扰动响应预测与表示解耦。
summary.caveat: 摘要称优于现有模型与朴素基线但未给出量化指标，反事实预测的生物学验证仍有限。

papers.title: RAG-Enhanced LLMs for Interactive Explainability in Clinical Decision Support Systems
papers.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is increasingly embedded in high-risks decision-making systems across domains such as healthcare, finance, and the judicial system. As reliance on predictive models grows, so does the demand for Explainable AI (XAI) to ensure transparency, trust, and interpretability. However, existing XAI approaches often fail to present explanations in a format accessible to domain experts, limiting their practical utility. Large Language Models (LLMs) have recently emerged as a bridge between complex models and end-users, offering natural language explanations. Yet, their use introduces new risks, including hallucinated outputs and lack of source traceability. To address these challenges, we propose a Clinical Decision Support System (CDSS) that not only combines standard predictive models with XAI techniques but also incorporates a Retrieval-Augmented Generation module as an interactive enhancer. This module grounds explanations in verified medical knowledge, reformulates technical outputs into a human-like format, and enables users-such as clinicians-to actively query the system. By fostering an interactive, human-in-the-loop environment, our approach empowers domain experts to explore model decisions, contextualize explanations, and build trust in AI-assisted diagnostics. The study concludes with preliminary experiments validating the proposed methodology.

summary.takeaway: 提出结合预测模型、可解释AI与检索增强生成的临床决策支持系统，用RAG将解释锚定在医学知识中并支持临床医生交互查询。
summary.methods: 将标准预测模型与XAI技术结合，加入RAG模块以验证过的医学知识为解释提供依据，把技术输出改写为自然语言并支持用户追问，构建人在回路交互环境；摘要仅称有初步实验验证。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与检索增强及对齐主题，关注RAG在可解释性与可信性上的应用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅提及初步实验，未报告具体评估指标、数据集规模或与基线的对比结果。

papers.title: Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline for Multi-Instance Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We present the Adaptive Scheduling Pipeline (ASP), an offline rollout scheduler for multi-instance asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models (LLMs). ASP jointly reduces three sources of rollout underutilization - padding bubbles from intra-minibatch length heterogeneity, skewness bubbles from long-tail outputs, and sorting bubbles from fluctuations in training-queue occupancy induced by length-sorted dispatch - through a single offline preprocessing pass. This enables efficient multi-instance rollout that overcomes the early scaling plateau of single-instance inference while smoothing the arrival of generated samples at the trainer. We integrate the scheduler into an asynchronous architecture that decouples rollout from training while keeping policy lag observable and bounded. Complete ASP improves end-to-end throughput by up to 3.22 times and reduces iteration time by up to 76.8% relative to MindSpeed-RL, while reducing iteration time by up to 62.5% relative to verl. Within ASP, scheduling reduces mean iteration time by 10.9%. ASP also scales more robustly with additional generation resources than these baselines and shows no visible convergence degradation in the measured bounded-lag regime. ASP has since been used in an internal telecom-domain RL post-training workflow, reducing the reported training period from more than three months to about two months and producing a domain-enhanced model for knowledge answering and tool calling.

summary.takeaway: 提出ASP离线调度流水线，通过一次离线预处理同时减少多实例异步强化学习中的填充气泡、长尾偏斜气泡和排序气泡，提升大语言模型RL训练的吞吐。
summary.methods: 将调度器集成到解耦rollout与训练的异步架构中，保持策略滞后可观测且有界；相对MindSpeed-RL与verl比较端到端吞吐与迭代时间，并报告内部电信领域RL后训练的使用情况。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与强化学习主题，涉及RL后训练的系统效率。
summary.caveat: 性能提升数字针对特定基线与环境，收敛无退化的结论限于所测的有界滞后区间，内部工作流数据为报告性质。

papers.title: Zero-Shot Benchmarking of Unified Multimodal Models for Shallow-Water UAV Image Distortion Assessment and Restoration
papers.abstract: Shallow-water UAV imagery provides centimeter-scale observations of benthic environments, but water-induced distortions complicate interpretation. To our knowledge, we present the first systematic zero-shot benchmark of unified multimodal large language models (MLLMs) for both assessing water-induced distortions and restoring shallow-water imagery within the same model framework. We evaluate five open-weight unified MLLMs with frozen pretrained weights and without access to paired reference images or descriptions of the true seabed. The benchmark contains 1,000 image pairs: 600 semi-synthetic UAV scenes created by applying synthetic water distortions to real shallow-water imagery and 400 fully synthetic through-water scenes. Three independent human annotations cover five distortion types. We evaluate four assessment prompts (P0-P3), from direct instruction to structured task decomposition, on all 1,000 images and four diagnosis-guided restoration prompts (R0-R3) on a common 100-image subset. Assessment varies substantially by model and prompt, with systematic prediction biases and a best pooled balanced accuracy of 0.654 for distortion presence. The best pooled PSNR gain is +0.255 dB, no unified MLLM improves pooled LPIPS, and some outputs alter scene structure or hallucinate content. Two restoration-only baselines also show limited transfer: InstructIR achieves a pooled PSNR gain of +0.040 dB, while PromptFix degrades all four pooled metrics under every prompt. These results show that recognizing shallow-water degradation does not imply reliable physical restoration and provide a reproducible baseline for future work.

summary.takeaway: 给出首个针对浅水UAV图像水体畸变评估与复原的统一多模态大模型零样本基准，发现识别畸变并不等于能可靠复原。
summary.methods: 在预训练权重冻结、无配对参考图像与真实海底描述条件下评估五个开源统一MLLM；基准含1000对图像（600半合成、400全合成），五类畸变由三名独立人工标注；评估四种评估提示（P0-P3）与四种诊断引导复原提示（R0-R3），并比较InstructIR与PromptFix两个复原专用基线。
summary.relevance: 对应大语言模型与多模态学习主题，涉及多模态模型零样本能力评测。
summary.caveat: 最佳汇总平衡准确率仅0.654，最佳PSNR增益+0.255 dB且LPIPS未改善，部分输出会改变场景结构或产生幻觉，结果依赖合成畸变数据。

papers.title: An Effective Spoken Language Understanding Approach Leveraging Query-Adaptive Intent Detection
papers.abstract: Large language models enable fine-tuning-free spoken language understanding (SLU) through in-context learning, but direct query-based retrieval may select semantically similar yet intent irrelevant demonstrations. This paper presents Query-Adaptive Intent Detection via Prototype Extraction (APEX), a two-stage retrieval framework that first selects candidate intents using intent-level prototypes and then retrieves contextual exemplars within the selected intent space. Experiments on the SLURP dataset evaluate joint SLU performance using Exact Match Accuracy (EMA) under full-transcript and perplexity-stratified conditions, with additional retrieval analysis on ASR-generated transcripts. Compared with query-based retrieval, APEX improves EMA by 4.34 and 3.97 percentage points with Qwen3 4B and Gemma-3-4B, respectively, on full transcripts. Under high-perplexity inputs, APEX also yields EMA gains of 7.66 and 2.13 percentage points. Retrieval analysis further indicates that prototype-guided candidate selection achieves higher ground truth intent coverage across multiple input conditions.

summary.takeaway: 提出APEX两阶段检索框架：先利用意图级原型选择候选意图，再在选定意图空间内检索上下文示例，以改进基于上下文学习的口语理解。
summary.methods: 在SLURP数据集上，以Exact Match Accuracy（EMA）评估联合SLU性能，覆盖完整转写与按困惑度分层条件，并在ASR转写上进行检索分析；对比Qwen3 4B与Gemma-3-4B。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于大语言模型检索增强与对齐方向，针对上下文学习中示例检索的意图相关性问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出相对提升（如4.34与3.97个百分点），未报告绝对EMA；且实验限于SLURP数据集与两个模型。

papers.title: LEMMO: A Large Electromagnetic Model leveraging Pretrained LLMs for Million-Sample Signal Understanding
papers.abstract: Large language models have expanded beyond text to vision, audio, and other modalities, but understanding raw electromagnetic (EM) signals remains challenging. Wideband recordings can contain millions of samples, whereas existing waveform-based EM models are primarily evaluated on short in-phase and quadrature (IQ) segments, leaving long-recording understanding and detailed description insufficiently explored. We introduce LEMMO, a large EM model for instruction-driven recognition and description of long raw IQ recordings. LEMMO combines a linear-attention EM encoder with anti-aliased temporal resampling to process up to eight million complex samples. Its EM-text interaction module conditions learnable queries on instructions before retrieving signal evidence. Compact queries support recognition, while structured queries with auxiliary factual supervision organize scene-level properties, signal attributes, and cross-signal relationships for detailed description. We also construct and release a unified 1.38-TB corpus of real-world and synthetic EM signals, including LEMMO-ShortQA and LEMMO-LongDesc. Compared with MERLIN-LoRA, LEMMO improves mean EM-Bench perception accuracy by 15.77 %, mean strategy-generation ROUGE-L F1 by 4.38 points, and mean LEMMO-ShortQA accuracy by 14.31 %. It also improves categorical and numerical fact F1 on both LEMMO-LongDesc tasks while preserving its language backbone's MMLU performance. Our code and datasets are available at https://github.com/N1rv4n4/LEMMO and https://huggingface.co/datasets/DaftJun/RFLAS, respectively.

summary.takeaway: 提出LEMMO，一个面向长原始IQ电磁信号指令驱动识别与描述的大型电磁模型，并发布统一的大规模电磁信号语料。
summary.methods: 结合线性注意力电磁编码器与抗混叠时间重采样，可处理多达八百万复样本；通过电磁-文本交互模块以指令条件化可学习查询；构建1.38-TB真实与合成语料，含LEMMO-ShortQA与LEMMO-LongDesc。
summary.relevance: 该工作与大语言模型及检索增强/对齐相关，展示将预训练LLM扩展到非文本模态并进行指令驱动信号理解。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的对比主要针对MERLIN-LoRA基线，且未说明长记录理解在何种分布或真实部署条件下评估。

papers.title: Large Language Model Consensus and Corpus-Adaptive Topic Modeling for Classifying and Mapping Patent Innovation
papers.abstract: Patent analytics increasingly relies on transformer representations and large language models (LLMs), yet linking conceptual classification, topic formation and interpretation requires explicit decisions about model roles and the evidence retained at each stage. In this design-oriented study, we propose and demonstrate a patent analytics pipeline that links these tasks and keeps each decision open to audit. Three LLMs separately classify each patent by novelty (radical or incremental) and innovation type (product, process, service). Radical and innovation-type labels each require two supporting votes, with Incremental used as the fallback novelty label. Topics are discovered by clustering PatentSBERTa embeddings, with parameter ranges scaled to corpus size. A patent-specific stopword list is applied only when topics are represented with class-based term frequency--inverse document frequency (c-TF-IDF), and a second embedding model supports inter-topic similarity, hierarchical refinement and visualization. An LLM then labels each topic from its ranked keywords and representative patents. We demonstrate the pipeline on 30,964 public-sector-related patents retrieved from Lens.org. Across five category corpora ranging from 591 to 29,215 patents, the pipeline produced 74 category-specific topic instances with a macro-average document coverage of 98.1% and topic diversity of 0.900--1.000, and fewer than 1% of classification outputs returned UNKNOWN. Because every model vote and the evidence behind each topic label are retained, analysts can audit and revise the outputs. The demonstration establishes the feasibility and traceability of the pipeline; testing its labels against expert coding and benchmarking it against alternative pipelines are identified as the next steps. The pipeline offers a reusable basis for LLM-assisted patent analysis in technology intelligence.

summary.takeaway: 提出并演示一条可审计的专利分析流水线，将LLM分类、主题建模与主题标签生成连接起来。
summary.methods: 三个LLM分别对专利的新颖性与创新类型分类，需两票支持，Incremental为回退标签；用PatentSBERTa嵌入聚类发现主题，c-TF-IDF表示主题并辅以第二嵌入模型做主题间相似度与层级细化；由LLM依据关键词和代表专利为各主题命名。在Lens.org检索的30,964件公共部门相关专利上演示。
summary.relevance: 属于大语言模型应用与检索增强方向，强调模型角色分工与证据留存以支持审计。
summary.caveat: 作者明确指出该演示仅确立可行性与可追溯性，尚未用专家编码验证标签或与其他流水线基准比较。

papers.title: Does Reasoning Improve Psychological Depth in Large Language Models?
papers.abstract: Benchmark gains from reasoning-enhanced large language models encourage the assumption that these models should broadly perform better on complex generative tasks, but this remains underexplored in open-ended, creative domains shaped by nuances of reader experience. We tested this assumption through the lens of psychological depth in short stories. We compared DeepSeek-R1 vs. DeepSeek-V3, our closest available contrast for reasoning-oriented post-training, and GPT-5 vs. GPT-4o, through 60 blinded pairwise evaluations in which seven human annotators and an ensemble LLM-as-a-Judge rated prompt-matched story outputs. Human evaluations showed no universal reasoning advantage: GPT-5 was slightly preferred over GPT-4o (60.0-62.9% across two reasoning-effort settings), whereas DeepSeek-R1 fell behind DeepSeek-V3 (42.9%). Although this pattern was marked by low inter-annotator agreement (Krippendorff's $α= 0.070$), our annotation-quality checks suggested genuine evaluative subjectivity, plausibly reflecting distinct annotator decision schemes rather than annotation failure. In contrast, the LLM-as-a-Judge showed a strong pro-reasoning bias (98.3% of pairs vs. 55.2% of human votes), consistent across its five configurations and partly tracking sentence length. These findings suggest that, at the frontier, reasoning-related quality differences are small enough to be dominated by reader subjectivity, and that LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators can obscure this subjectivity in nuanced creative-generation tasks.

summary.takeaway: 通过短篇故事心理深度的盲评对比，发现推理增强模型并无普遍优势，且LLM-as-a-Judge存在明显偏向推理的偏差。
summary.methods: 比较DeepSeek-R1与DeepSeek-V3、GPT-5与GPT-4o，进行60组盲配对评估，由七名人类标注者和一个LLM评审集成打分；报告标注者间一致性并做标注质量检查。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型能力评估与对齐评价方法，尤其质疑LLM-as-a-Judge在开放式创作任务中的可靠性。
summary.caveat: 人类标注者间一致性很低（Krippendorff's α=0.070），样本为60组配对，结论受主观性与规模限制。

papers.title: On the Reliability of Majority-Vote Pseudo-Labels in Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) adapts pretrained language models to unlabeled target-domain data using self-generated pseudo-labels, whose reliability remains poorly understood. We analyze majority-vote supervision for TTRL with online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and decompose its error into population-majority bias and prompt-dependent finite-rollout variation. Because population-majority bias is generally unidentifiable without external supervision, we focus on mitigating the downstream effects of finite-rollout variation. We propose \emph{Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO (PC-Dr.DPO)}, which conditions within-prompt robust reweighting on observed vote reliability to make updates from sampling-sensitive prompts more conservative. We further introduce a cache-based mechanism to reduce self-supervised forgetting during online adaptation. Across six mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks and five model backbones, PC-Dr.DPO matches or outperforms the strongest TTRL baseline in 24 of 30 settings.

summary.takeaway: 分析测试时强化学习中多数投票伪标签的可靠性，将误差分解为总体多数偏差与提示相关有限 rollout 变异，并提出PC-Dr.DPO缓解后者影响。
summary.methods: 在线Direct Preference Optimization框架下提出Prompt-Conditional Distributionally Robust DPO，依据观测到的投票可靠性对提示内样本做稳健重加权，并引入缓存机制减少在线适应中的自监督遗忘；在六个数学与知识密集型推理基准、五个模型骨干上评估。
summary.relevance: 直接对应强化学习与检索/对齐主题，关注无标签目标域适应中的监督信号可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出总体多数偏差在无外部监督下通常不可识别，因此方法只处理有限 rollout 变异的后果。

papers.title: Not All Entropy Is Equal: Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
papers.abstract: Policy entropy is widely used to diagnose exploration and collapse in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), yet its magnitude does not consistently track reasoning performance across optimization objectives. We argue that this ambiguity arises because global token entropy conflates uncertainty in successful and failed trajectories, diversity across correct solution strategies, and variation among realizations of the same strategy. We introduce \textbf{Reward-Conditioned Entropy Allocation (RCEA)}, a hierarchical diagnostic framework that separates complete-trajectory entropy from average token entropy, conditions uncertainty on verifier outcome and process validity, measures correct-solution-mode retention, and connects these population-level quantities to local covariance-driven updates. In controlled sweeps over six RLVR objectives at two model scales, entropy trajectories do not induce a stable ordering of reasoning accuracy. Token entropy is higher for verifier-failed than successful trajectories under both broad separately aggregated estimates and a common-question paired analysis, whose confidence intervals exclude equality at 10 of 12 displayed endpoints. A local covariance approximation predicts the direction of adjacent-checkpoint entropy change in 95.5\% of nonfailed transitions; a reward-stratified endpoint proxy further shows that positive chosen-token covariance is more tail-concentrated within failed prefixes. Every reportable trained endpoint exhibits some contraction in independently audited correct-solution-mode breadth, whose positive association with large-\(k\) coverage remains exploratory. These results show that entropy collapse should be diagnosed by which uncertainty is removed, rather than by global entropy alone.

summary.takeaway: 提出奖励条件化熵分配框架，主张熵坍缩应按被移除的不确定性类型诊断，而非仅看全局熵。
summary.methods: 将完整轨迹熵与平均token熵分离，按验证器结果与过程有效性条件化不确定性，度量正确解模式保留，并连接局部协方差更新；在两种模型规模、六个RLVR目标上做受控扫描。
summary.relevance: 属于强化学习与对齐方向，针对RLVR中探索与熵的诊断问题。
summary.caveat: 作者将正确解模式广度与大k覆盖的正关联标为探索性；部分分析基于局部协方差近似。

papers.title: TailDART: Compute-Efficient Foundation Models for Financial Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Although time-series foundation models (TSFMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability across high-information-density physical systems, applying overparameterized TSFMs to quantitative finance is fundamentally constrained by low signal-to-noise ratios, non-stationarity, and prohibitive autoregressive decoding latency. To reconcile representation learning with institutional operational constraints, this study presents TailDART, a dense 2.68 million-parameter foundation model engineered for financial time-series forecasting. By integrating grouped-query attention into a lightweight backbone, the architecture drastically reduces Key-Value cache memory bandwidth overhead, achieving major inference acceleration (up to 48.1%) over prevailing state-of-the-art TSFMs to enable low-latency, high-throughput streaming execution. Furthermore, multi-asset benchmarks across varying temporal resolutions show that a compact model can remain competitive for market forecasting: TailDART matches the predictive fidelity of substantially larger baselines while demonstrating superior error resilience in high-volatility regimes.

summary.takeaway: 提出面向金融时间序列预测的紧凑基础模型TailDART，以轻量架构在保持预测竞争力的同时显著降低推理开销。
summary.methods: 采用268万参数的稠密骨干并集成grouped-query attention以减少KV缓存内存带宽；在多资产、不同时间分辨率基准上与更大的TSFM基线比较。
summary.relevance: 对应预训练与表示学习主题，探讨基础模型在低信噪比金融场景中的计算高效适配。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明与更大基线预测保真度相当及在高波动区间误差韧性更好，未给出具体误差指标；评估限于金融时间序列。

papers.title: BrainCoT: A Multi-Task Zero-Shot Brain Signal Foundation Model with Neurometric-Anchored Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
papers.abstract: Brain signals exhibit substantial multi-center heterogeneity, strong inter-subject variability, and highly diverse task settings, which makes it difficult to build models that generalize beyond a single task. While recent brain signal foundation models leverage large-scale pretraining to learn generalizable representations, they often fall short in practice because they still require target-data-specific supervised adaptation, lack multi-task zero-shot capability, and rarely provide verifiable evidence to support their predictions. In this work, we present BrainCoT, a multi-task zero-shot Brain signal foundation model with neurometric-anchored Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning. BrainCoT unifies heterogeneous tasks into an instruction-driven framework so that, after pretraining, a single model can be directly applied to multiple tasks in zero-shot settings without additional adaptation. It further introduces neurometric-anchored chain-of-thought grounded in neurometric evidence for verifiable reasoning, and adopts Decision-Consistent Rationale Training to keep process learning aligned with correct predictions. Across extensive evaluations, BrainCoT achieves an average ACC of 67.41% and AUC of 74.33% in zero-shot classification without downstream training data, outperforming the strongest linear-probing baseline trained with 1% labeled downstream data by 3.85% in ACC and 5.97% in AUC.

summary.takeaway: 提出BrainCoT，一个多任务零样本脑信号基础模型，通过神经度量锚定的思维链推理提供可验证依据。
summary.methods: 将异构任务统一为指令驱动框架，预训练后可直接零样本用于多任务；引入基于神经度量证据的思维链与Decision-Consistent Rationale Training；在零样本分类中报告平均ACC 67.41%、AUC 74.33%。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练与对齐/推理方向，关注跨任务泛化与可验证推理。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告零样本分类指标，并与使用1%下游标注数据的最强线性探针基线比较；其他任务类型的具体表现未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: Safety-Focused Reinforcement Learning Using Risk-Sensitive Coupled Control
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the coupled control problem within safety-focused reinforcement learning, addressing the essential challenge of achieving optimal performance while ensuring safety in systems operating within complex environments. We define safety as the requirement to prevent the system from reaching undesirable or hazardous states. We propose a coupled control approach that prioritizes safety by employing effective methods to prevent the system from entering unsafe states while optimizing the performance metric, defined as the average cost. We propose a novel problem transformation that reformulates it into a risk-sensitive problem combined with an average reward criterion. We present a two-timescale Q-learning algorithm where in the faster timescale, the algorithm solves a risk-sensitive control problem to ensure safety, while on a slower timescale, the algorithm focuses on average cost control. We provide theoretical guarantees for the convergence of our algorithms, establishing their significance in ensuring safe, optimal control in dynamic environments. We validated the performance of our approach using GridWorld and CarGoal task in Safety Gymnasium.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种面向安全强化学习的耦合控制方法，将安全约束转化为风险敏感控制问题并与平均代价优化分离求解。
summary.methods: 设计两时间尺度 Q-learning：较快尺度求解风险敏感控制以保证安全，较慢尺度优化平均代价；给出收敛性理论保证，并在 GridWorld 与 Safety Gymnasium 的 CarGoal 任务上验证。
summary.relevance: 直接对应强化学习主题，关注复杂环境中兼顾性能与安全的状态规避控制。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告实验任务，未给出具体性能数值或与基线的定量对比；理论保证依赖的假设条件未在摘要中说明。

papers.title: The Cost of Coverage: Conformalising Native Forecast Uncertainty for GB Wind Power
papers.abstract: Uncertainty bands on wind forecasts help inform reserve sizing and commitments, but often fail to deliver their stated coverage. We apply conformal prediction to native bands to see what it adds and what it costs, comparing six forecasters, from ARIMA to a tabular foundation model, at two wind farms in Great Britain (GB) under operational conditions. We show that calibration repairs empirical marginal coverage with little or no Winkler Score penalty, but this apparent success conceals under-coverage in high winds. Calibrating by forecast wind regime turns marginal coverage into regime-level coverage, cutting day-ahead out-of-band volume in high winds by over 40% relative to pooled calibration while narrowing bands overall.

summary.takeaway: 用保形预测校准风电功率预测的原生不确定性区间，发现校准可修复边际覆盖率但会掩盖高风速下的欠覆盖。
summary.methods: 在英国两个风电场、运行条件下比较从 ARIMA 到表格基础模型的六种预测器，采用保形预测进行校准，并按预测风速区间分层校准，以 Winkler Score 和带外体量评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及预测不确定性校准与基础模型预训练应用，与对齐/可靠性评估主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明边际校准几乎无 Winkler Score 损失且分层校准使高风速日前带外体量下降超 40%，但结论限于两个 GB 风电场和所比较的六种预测器。

papers.title: Syn2DRE: Synergistic Dual Teacher-Student Framework for Document-level Relation Extraction
papers.abstract: Document-level Relation Extraction (DocRE) aims to identify relations between entities across a document but typically relies on costly large-scale annotations. While pseudo-labelling enables the use of low-quality data, existing methods often suffer from inefficiency and confirmation bias. To address these challenges, we propose Syn2DRE, a semi-supervised framework that combines self-supervised learning with cross-supervision in a lightweight teacher-student architecture to produce more reliable pseudo-labels. Additionally, we introduce a unified end-to-end training strategy to further improve efficiency of the framework. Experiments on multiple benchmarks show that Syn2DRE consistently outperforms prior state-of-the-art semi-supervised DocRE methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Syn2DRE 半监督框架，通过双教师-学生架构结合自监督与交叉监督生成更可靠的伪标签，用于文档级关系抽取。
summary.methods: 采用轻量教师-学生结构进行自监督与交叉监督，引入统一端到端训练策略提升效率；在多个 DocRE 基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 对应图谱构建与表示学习主题，涉及利用低质量数据降低标注成本的关系抽取。
summary.caveat: 摘要称一致优于先前半监督 DocRE 方法，但未给出具体数据集名称或数值提升幅度。

papers.title: Towards Robust Automated Mouse Scratching Behavior Detection for Itch Research
papers.abstract: Quantification of mouse scratching behavior is essential for preclinical itch research. However, manual video annotation is labor-intensive, and automated detection remains challenging in terms of accuracy and generalizability. We present Scratch-AID+, a computational framework dedicated to automated mouse scratching detection, including a diverse and progressive set of model families and learning strategies: classic ResNet-based detectors, task-adaptive fine-tuning of video foundation models, and in-context learning of advanced multimodal large language models. To simulate real-world use cases, we benchmark on a public dataset containing annotated video recordings from a source laboratory with additional cross-laboratory videos for independent testing, and we explore different data preprocessing and training configurations. We find that classic models suffer severe performance degradation on external data under our realistic setting with sparse scratching events. In contrast, fine-tuned video foundation models substantially improve the generalizability, achieving significantly better detection performance. Furthermore, frozen multimodal large language models demonstrate promising out-of-the-box ability using only few-shot demonstrations.We also report the effects of different video preprocessing strategies and ablations. Our findings highlight the improved performance and generalizability of the adapted foundation models for automated scratching behavior analysis and shed light on the real-world deployment of such detectors. Our code is publicly available at github.com/PennShenLab/scratch-aid-plus.

summary.takeaway: 构建 Scratch-AID+ 框架系统比较经典检测器、视频基础模型微调与多模态大模型上下文学习在小鼠抓挠行为自动检测中的泛化表现。
summary.methods: 在含源实验室标注视频的公开数据集及额外跨实验室视频上基准测试，比较 ResNet 检测器、视频基础模型任务自适应微调、冻结多模态大模型少样本演示，并考察预处理与消融配置。
summary.relevance: 涉及基础模型与多模态大模型在生物行为分析中的迁移与泛化，对应预训练与多模态学习主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体检测精度数值；跨实验室测试设置仍属有限场景，实际部署泛化性需更多验证。

papers.title: scPhyloGRN: gene regulatory network inference guided by lineage topology in single-cell developmental data.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Gene regulatory network (GRN) inference from single-cell transcriptomes is complicated by expression patterns associated with both cell state and shared ancestry. Cellular phylogenies provide developmental context, but incorporating relationships among individual cells into gene-level regulatory inference remains challenging. RESULTS: We present scPhyloGRN, a supervised framework that integrates single-cell gene expression with cellular phylogeny to prioritize directed transcription factor (TF)-target candidates within the observed gene set. The framework maps cell ancestry to gene associations that guide graph construction, attention in a dual-stream encoder, and lineage-consistency regularization. We evaluated scPhyloGRN against ten methods across 17 dataset-reference settings spanning four mouse embryos and one Caenorhabditis elegans dataset. scPhyloGRN showed an overall advantage in regulatory edge prioritization, supported by additional evaluations using shared candidate spaces. Removing lineage information reduced AUPRC in the ablation analyses, while branch-level and regulator-level analyses showed improved ranking and recovery of reference-supported regulatory candidates. AVAILABILITY AND IMPLEMENTATION: Source code and analysis workflows are available at https://github.com/Maria0852/scPhyloGRN, with a versioned archive at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22793831.

summary.takeaway: 提出 scPhyloGRN 监督框架，将单细胞表达与细胞谱系拓扑结合，用于优先排序有向转录因子-靶基因候选关系。
summary.methods: 将细胞祖先关系映射为基因关联，指导图构建、双流编码器注意力与谱系一致性正则化；在 17 个数据集-参考设置（四个小鼠胚胎与一个线虫数据集）中与十种方法比较。
summary.relevance: 直接对应 GRN/Regulon 主题，关注单细胞发育数据中的基因调控网络推断。
summary.caveat: 结果为在所评估设置中的总体优势，消融显示去除谱系信息降低 AUPRC；摘要未给出具体 AUPRC 数值，且候选空间限于观测基因集。

papers.title: RPFace: From biased structural benchmarks to generalizable RNA-protein interface prediction
papers.abstract: Modeling protein-RNA complexes with co-folding and docking methods is routine, yet these methods are evaluated on benchmarks whose composition mirrors the deposited structures on which they were trained or tuned, leaving open whether their reported performance reflects true generalization. Here, we focus the evaluation on the region that carries the biological signal: the binding interface. For the first time, we construct and release a fair benchmark that stratifies protein-RNA data into distinct structural and experimental groups, providing a more stringent test of generalization than aggregate averages. On this benchmark, we find that accuracy of detecting the binding site using co-folding methods is concentrated in ribosomal complexes and varies systematically with factors such as experimental modality. For docking methods, it is reliable only when the input conformations are already close to the bound state, and it is inconsistent across RNA classes. Both families of methods fail to transfer to in vivo CLIP experiments. To address this gap, we introduce RPFace, to the best of our knowledge the first model that jointly predicts the binding preference of every protein residue and every RNA nucleotide directly from sequence, requiring no experimental structure, template, or multiple sequence alignment. RPFace combines an ensemble of predicted secondary structures with a multi-modal embedding-enrichment scheme that fuses representations from RNA foundation models and structure prediction models. Unlike existing approaches, it is a very small and fast model that delivers stable performance across structural and experimental conditions, is robust to conformational change, and generalizes to in vivo datasets without extensive pretraining. As a result, RPFace matches the state-of-the-art methods on protein interfaces with no evolutionary information, and outperforms them on RNA interfaces, with the largest gains in zero-shot settings despite using only sequence information. The model, code, and data are available at Github.

summary.takeaway: 构建按结构与实验条件分层的公平蛋白质-RNA 基准，揭示共折叠与对接方法在界面检测上的泛化缺陷，并提出仅用序列的 RPFace 模型。
summary.methods: 对蛋白质-RNA 数据按结构组和实验组分层评测共折叠与对接方法的界面检测；RPFace 融合预测二级结构集成、RNA 基础模型与结构预测模型的多模态嵌入增强，无需实验结构、模板或多序列比对。
summary.relevance: 涉及基础模型与预训练表示在生物分子界面预测中的迁移和零样本泛化。
summary.caveat: 摘要中的性能比较为相对定性描述（匹配或超越现有方法），未给出具体指标数值；基准和结论集中于蛋白质-RNA 界面任务。

papers.title: AdaAlloc: Adaptive Visual Token Allocation for Long-Video Question Answering
papers.abstract: Long-video question answering forces multimodal large language models to reason under strict visual-token budgets, creating a tradeoff between broad temporal coverage and fine-grained spatial detail. Uniform sampling preserves coverage but often obscures decisive local cues, while caption-based or frame-similarity retrieval operates over lossy proxies that can miss motion, state changes, and before-after relations. We recast long-video reasoning as a visual-token allocation problem: given a fixed budget, decide how much to spend on global context versus high-resolution local evidence, and where in the video to draw that local evidence from. We introduce AdaAlloc, a training-free inference framework that adaptively allocates visual tokens between a global video overview and localized visual detail. AdaAlloc first plans a global/local allocation policy, then uses temporal grounding to locate candidate evidence segments and refines them into a compact temporal memory. The selected policy controls both frame sampling density and resolution, combining sparse, lower-resolution global frames with denser, higher-resolution local frames drawn from the refined memory. The final answerer reasons over the allocated global context and refined local evidence. Across LVBench, MLVU, VideoMME, and LongVideoBench, AdaAlloc improves over budget-matched uniform sampling by up to 10.5 percentage points and outperforms the compared frame-selection and agentic methods on their reported benchmarks.

summary.takeaway: 将长视频问答重构为视觉 token 分配问题，提出免训练框架 AdaAlloc 在全局概览与高分辨率局部证据之间自适应分配预算。
summary.methods: 先规划全局/局部 token 分配策略，再用时间定位找到候选证据片段并精炼为紧凑时间记忆，由策略控制帧采样密度与分辨率；在 LVBench、MLVU、VideoMME、LongVideoBench 上评估。
summary.relevance: 对应多模态大模型与检索增强/对齐主题，关注长视频推理中的证据检索与 token 预算权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告相对预算匹配均匀采样最高提升 10.5 个百分点，但结果限于所列基准和所比较的帧选择与智能体方法。

papers.title: Seeing What Matters: Benchmarking Task-Conditioned Actionable Spatial Belief for Manipulation
papers.abstract: When should a robot look at the cup, and when at the portafilter? Spatial-reasoning benchmarks evaluate whether a model can describe a scene, but manipulation needs something more specific: the ability to acquire the particular evidence that makes the current command executable. A view that is informative for one task can be useless for another, even at the same workstation. We introduce Seeing What Matters, a benchmark for task-conditioned actionable spatial belief in simulated tabletop manipulation. Across three domains--coffee workstation, drawer/cabinet, and microwave/appliance--the benchmark provides 860 frozen evaluation cases; expanding across methods, budgets, and inference repeats yields more than 115,000 evaluator episodes under two protocols: closed-loop actionability and same-object functional out-of-distribution generalization. Each case pairs a set of candidate RGB views with a manipulation command, shared scripted skills, and hidden postconditions, so the benchmark directly measures whether a view-selection policy acquires the observations its command actually needs. We also provide a diagnostic reference pipeline that maintains a spatial-functional belief state and ranks views by missing evidence. At primary budget settings, this pipeline reaches 98.8% closed-loop and 98.9% functional-OOD success; ablating the functional or command-binding components collapses performance to near zero. Seven vision-language models, evaluated on the same cases, reach only 26-43%. Replacing the reference pipeline's coverage metadata with frozen RGB-derived scores preserves 98.5%/98.9% success; shuffling the visual scores collapses it to 15%/11%, confirming that the result depends on image content. These gaps suggest that spatial belief for manipulation should be evaluated not by scene-level completeness, but by whether it acquires the evidence the current command requires.

summary.takeaway: 提出任务条件化可操作空间信念基准 Seeing What Matters，衡量视角选择策略是否获取当前操作命令真正需要的证据。
summary.methods: 在咖啡工作站、抽屉/柜子、微波炉/电器三个模拟桌面操作域构建 860 个冻结评测案例，提供两种协议（闭环可执行性与同物体功能 OOD 泛化），并给出维护空间-功能信念状态的诊断参考流程；同时评测七种视觉语言模型。
summary.relevance: 涉及多模态视觉语言模型在具身操作中的空间推理与证据获取，与多模态学习和跨模态理解主题相关。
summary.caveat: 基准为模拟桌面场景，摘要报告的参考流程成功率与视觉语言模型 26-43% 的差距来自该受控设置，真实机器人迁移未验证。

papers.title: Multimodal Training with Knowledge Traction for Video Anomaly Detection
papers.abstract: The task of weakly supervised video anomaly detection is challenging. Existing approaches mainly model video frame features and determine whether anomalies are present based on their magnitudes. In this work, we propose a novel method that incorporates external knowledge into training to improve model performance, robustness, and generalization. We leverage textual prompts and a large language model (LLM) to establish prior information for the specific task, and employ dictionary learning to normalize and compress this information. Moreover, during experiments, we observed inconsistencies in the textual descriptions extracted from similar video frames by image caption models. To address this, we devise a method that leverages an LLM and auxiliary information to ensure consistency in the textual descriptions of similar frames within a video. Finally, we introduce a feature processing approach that incorporates prior knowledge and cross-modal attention mechanisms. This approach learns the relationships and characteristics among different modalities to construct more accurate and reliable feature representations, thereby improving the accuracy and stability of downstream tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that our method surpasses other state-of-the-art approaches.

summary.takeaway: 将LLM生成的先验知识与跨模态注意力引入弱监督视频异常检测，以提升性能、鲁棒性和泛化能力。
summary.methods: 利用文本提示和LLM建立任务先验，用字典学习对先验信息做规范化与压缩；针对相似帧图像描述不一致的问题，借助LLM和辅助信息保证描述一致性；并设计融合先验知识与跨模态注意力的特征处理方式。
summary.relevance: 涉及大语言模型、跨模态理解与对齐，以及利用外部知识增强模型训练，与匹配主题直接相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出定性结论（超过其他SOTA方法），未提供数据集、指标数值或消融结果，具体增益幅度无法从摘要判断。

papers.title: MARS: Training Multilingual Search Agents for Retriever-Free Evidence Acquisition
papers.abstract: Existing multilingual retrieval-augmented generation relies heavily on learned retrievers and similarity-based ranking from multilingual collections, which are vulnerable to cross-lingual retrieval errors and indexing overhead. In this paper, we explore retriever-free multilingual search, where the model directly interacts with raw corpora through executable shell commands. This paradigm shifts the bottleneck to multilingual search action generation, where exact search is sensitive to entity surface forms and outcome-only supervision provides limited guidance for multi-turn search. To address these challenges, we propose MARS, a multilingual search agent in direct corpus interaction (DCI) with reinforcement learning (RL). MARS introduces corpus-native entity grounding to recover reliable lexical anchors from corpus evidence, mitigating failure to retrieve evidence. Meanwhile, we present a redundancy-aware search reward to encourage concise and effective search trajectories, addressing training collapse in RL of multilingual scenarios. Experiments show that \ours~consistently outperforms strong retrieval-based and DCI baselines, while demonstrating robust cross-lingual generalization and substantially reducing redundant corpus interactions.

summary.takeaway: 提出无需检索器的多语言搜索智能体MARS，通过直接语料交互和强化学习完成跨语言证据获取。
summary.methods: 模型用可执行shell命令与原始语料交互；引入语料原生实体接地以恢复可靠词汇锚点，并设计冗余感知搜索奖励，用强化学习训练多轮搜索轨迹。
summary.relevance: 属于检索增强与对齐及强化学习主题，探索以智能体直接检索替代传统多语言检索器与相似度排序。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体基准、语言覆盖和量化结果，仅称在实验中持续优于检索式与DCI基线；跨语言泛化的具体程度需看全文。

papers.title: RNA-X: Modeling RNA interactions to design binder RNA and simultaneously target multiple molecules of different types
papers.abstract: RNA interactions with proteins, other RNA molecules, and DNA play essential roles in numerous cellular processes and underpin a wide range of therapeutic mechanisms. Consequently, modeling these interactions is critical for understanding biological systems and designing novel RNA-based therapeutics. However, designing RNA sequences that selectively and strongly bind to a specific target remains a major challenge due to the vast sequence space and the current limitations of experimental and computational methods. In this study, we introduce RNA-X, the first RNA interaction foundation model which is based on masked language modeling for representation learning, conditional RNA design, and optimization. For the first time, RNA-X enables (i) RNA design targeting not only proteins but also other RNA and DNA molecules, and (ii) simultaneous design against multiple targets. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that RNA-X generates RNA sequences with natural structural characteristics and surpasses state-of-the-art methods in protein targeting. We experimentally validate RNA-X in vitro, where a RNAX-designed RNA targeting the 5'UTR of the androgen receptor (AR) mRNA was shown to reduce both AR transcript and protein levels in prostate cancer cells. Using affinity predictors and molecular dynamics simulations, we further show that the model can design RNA molecules that (i) target therapeutically relevant molecules such as p53 and thrombin proteins, and (ii) bind to targets with no prior interaction data, such as PHF6 protein. As a proof of concept, we designed a novel guide RNA from scratch that simultaneously binds (i) to the DNA of a bacterium and (ii) to the Cas9 protein. The resulting design achieves a predicted binding energy comparable to that of the wild-type guide RNA reported in the Protein Data Bank. Despite having orders of magnitude fewer parameters than existing RNA foundation models, RNA-X produces representations that outperform them across diverse RNA interaction-related downstream tasks. The code and pretrained model are publicly available on GitHub.

summary.takeaway: 提出首个RNA相互作用基础模型RNA-X，支持面向蛋白、RNA和DNA的RNA设计，并可同时靶向多个靶标。
summary.methods: 基于掩码语言建模进行表征学习、条件RNA设计与优化；在体外实验验证靶向AR mRNA 5'UTR的设计，并用亲和力预测与分子动力学模拟评估p53、凝血酶及无先验互作数据的PHF6等靶标，还从零设计同时结合细菌DNA与Cas9的guide RNA。
summary.relevance: 属于预训练与自监督表示学习在RNA相互作用建模中的应用，与生物分子设计主题相关。
summary.caveat: 多数结合效果来自计算预测与模拟，实验验证仅覆盖AR一个案例；多靶标同时设计的实验证据有限，需区分预测结论与实测结论。

papers.title: Protify: A Benchmarking Platform Revealing Task Dependence and Homology Leakage in Protein Language Model Evaluation
papers.abstract: Protein Language Models (pLMs) have become essential tools for computational protein analysis, and the rapid proliferation of architectures, training objectives, and pretraining corpora has produced a diverse and expanding model landscape. Evaluation practices, however, remain fragmented: studies use different datasets, preprocessing pipelines, and reporting conventions, so results rarely transfer between publications. Here we introduce Protify, an open-source platform that standardizes pLM benchmarking across zero-shot, supervised, and transferlearning settings through a unified, low-code interface. Protify currently supports 35 pretrained models and 61 curated datasets and it is easy to add custom versions of each. Leveraging Protify's high throughput pipelines, we benchmarked 23 models on ProteinGym, discovering that DPLM3B is currently the top-performing self-supervised encoder. Another large-scale supervised evaluation across 32 diverse tasks, spanning enzyme classification, gene ontology annotation, protein-protein interaction, subcellular localization, and other functional properties, found that no single pLM dominated: 14 different models took the top score on at least one dataset, and the margins between the best and second-best models fell within run-to-run variability. On enzyme optimal pH prediction, a general-purpose probe pipeline matched or exceeded EpHod, a specialized model selected from 11,550 training runs, after 50 hyperparameter trials (R2 = 0.482 versus 0.425). Under a homology-controlled split of the same data, every pooled-embedding probe collapsed to near-zero R2, and only a transformer probe over full residue embeddings recovered appreciable signal (R2 = 0.248). Model rankings therefore depend as much on evaluation design as on the models themselves. Protify makes those design choices explicit, controlled, and replayable, and is freely available at https://github.com/Gleghorn-Lab/Protify.

summary.takeaway: 推出开源蛋白质语言模型基准平台Protify，并揭示模型排名高度依赖评测设计，且同源泄漏会显著影响结果。
summary.methods: 统一零样本、监督和迁移学习评测接口，支持35个预训练模型和61个整理数据集；在ProteinGym上评测23个模型，并在32项监督任务上大规模评测，另做酶最适pH预测与同源控制划分实验。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练模型评测与检索/对齐中的基准设计问题，与匹配主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要本身即为该平台和评测结果，主要限制在于所覆盖模型与数据集范围有限；同源控制下信号大幅下降也说明结论依赖数据划分方式，具体排名不应外推。

papers.title: Plate design confounds donor variation and model evaluation in single-cell perturbation screens
papers.abstract: Single-cell screens of immune cells from many donors are used to study why individuals respond differently and to benchmark response models. Each donor-perturbation combination typically occupies one well, controls are grouped, and donors share one layout, so technical effects can look biological. Using a 90-cytokine screen, two compound screens, four cohorts and simulations, we show that well effects explain most replicate-control variation in abundant cell types, controls carry a shared offset, and identical control wells differ by hundreds of differentially expressed genes at a standard threshold, about as many as two receptor-negative proteins do. Negative controls, design-aware estimators and perturbation-specific evaluation change the interpretation of four recent analyses. A deep-learning model that scores below a perturbation-agnostic predictor under standard evaluation outperforms a simple baseline on perturbation-specific differences in two of three cell types (significantly in one with stricter controls), but predicts less well the component shared with inert wells.

summary.takeaway: 指出单细胞扰动筛选中的孔板设计会混淆供体差异与模型评估，技术效应可能被误读为生物学效应。
summary.methods: 基于90种细胞因子筛选、两个化合物筛选、四个队列及模拟，分析孔效应、对照偏移和差异表达基因数量，并用设计感知估计器与扰动特异性评估重新解读近期分析。
summary.relevance: 直接关系到单细胞扰动主题中的实验设计与模型评估可靠性。
summary.caveat: 摘要以多组筛选和模拟为主，结论的具体适用范围依赖其细胞类型与平台；关于深度学习模型表现的描述较概括，需全文核对统计细节。

papers.title: Multicellular Perturb-seq Reveals Lineage-Specific Transcriptional Control During Human Cardiac Organoid Development
papers.abstract: Heart development requires the coordinated differentiation of multiple cell lineages, including cardiomyocytes (CMs) and endothelial cells (ECs). Transcription factors (TFs) orchestrate lineage specification, morphogenesis, and maturation, yet how cardiac and vascular TFs shape multicellular organization and their interactions remain poorly understood. Many TFs exhibit pleiotropic and stage-dependent effects across cardiac lineages, particularly in cardiac progenitor cells, suggesting the presence of shared regulatory networks that synchronize cardiac and vascular programs during development and in response to stress. Human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) differentiated cardiac organoid provides a physiologically relevant 3D model to study these multicellular interactions, enabling simultaneous differentiation of ECs and CMs within a human genetic context. When combined with CRISPR interference (CRISPRi) based Perturb-seq, this system allows systematic, high-throughput dissection of TF-driven regulatory programs at single-cell resolution. In this study, we investigated how cardiac and vascular TFs coordinate lineage commitment and the cross-lineage signaling in human cardiovascular differentiation.

summary.takeaway: 结合hiPSC心脏类器官与CRISPRi Perturb-seq，研究心脏与血管转录因子如何协调谱系决定和跨谱系信号。
summary.methods: 利用人多能干细胞分化的心脏类器官同时分化心肌细胞和内皮细胞，并施加CRISPRi Perturb-seq，在单细胞分辨率上系统剖析转录因子驱动的调控程序。
summary.relevance: 属于单细胞扰动主题，展示多细胞体系中的谱系特异性转录调控研究框架。
summary.caveat: 摘要主要描述研究目标与体系，未给出具体转录因子、命中结果或验证结论，因此不能从摘要推断具体发现。

papers.title: Swallowing-Induced Ventricular Tachycardia: Mechanistic Inference and Patient Management Require Caution.

summary.takeaway: 该条目仅有标题，提示对吞咽诱发的室性心动过速进行机制推断和患者管理时需谨慎。
summary.methods: 摘要缺失，无法从现有信息判断所用方法或数据。
summary.relevance: 与机制推理主题相关，但摘要为空，无法评估其与本主题的具体关联程度。
summary.caveat: 缺少摘要与正文信息，方法、结果和限制均不可知；此解读仅依据标题，不应视为研究结论。

papers.title: Common attentional mechanisms, but distinct computational dynamics, across Statistical and Reward Learning
papers.abstract: Past experience guides attention through statistical learning (SL) and reward learning (RL). Yet, whether they do so through similar neural and computational mechanisms remains unclear. In a first EEG visual-search experiment, we tested whether RL establishes latent spatial representations, previously demonstrated for SL. Afterwards, we directly compared RL and SL in a double-session experiment. Using multivariate decoding, Experiment 1 showed that high-reward locations could be decoded before target onset following a task-irrelevant, spatially-unspecific visual perturbation. Experiment 2 revealed that SL and RL established comparable neural representations, and similarly facilitated target selection and evidence accumulation (drift-rate). However, combining Rescorla-Wagner and Drift Diffusion Model revealed slower learning-rate for RL than SL. Pupillometry further tracked spatially selective expectation violations during SL, but reflected increased arousal during RL. Together, our results reveal how the brain routes distinct computational algorithms (probability estimation versus value caching) into a unified attentional priority map.

summary.takeaway: 统计学习与奖励学习共享注意机制，但计算动态不同：二者建立可比的神经表征并促进目标选择，而奖励学习的学习率更慢。
summary.methods: 开展两次EEG视觉搜索实验：实验一检验奖励学习是否建立潜在空间表征，实验二直接比较统计学习与奖励学习；使用多变量解码、Rescorla-Wagner与漂移扩散模型联合建模及瞳孔测量。
summary.relevance: 与多智能体与奖励学习主题相关，涉及价值学习、期望违反和注意力优先级图的计算机制。
summary.caveat: 结论来自EEG视觉搜索范式，向其他任务或智能体场景的外推需谨慎；摘要未给出效应量与样本细节。

papers.title: Gene Regulatory Networks that Support Multi-fate Cellular Decisions.
papers.abstract: Cell fate decisions are driven by gene regulatory networks (GRNs). While the mutually inhibitory toggle switch effectively models binary fate decisions, fully connected inhibitory networks with more than two nodes fail to capture multi-fate decisions due to the low prevalence of "single high states", where only a single master regulator is highly expressed. The goal of this study is to find network structures that support all single high states. We find that the only network that attains the highest possible prevalence of all single high states within the set of monotone Boolean (MB) models is completely disconnected. Since biological networks typically require connectivity, we investigate network structures that support equipotency, where all single high states have equal prevalence within MB models. Finally, we characterize the networks that support multistability between all single high states, finding that it is possible only in networks in which each node either has self-activations or is inhibited by every other network node. Our findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding the network design principles that can support simultaneous differentiation into multiple distinct cell types.

summary.takeaway: 该研究从理论上刻画了单调布尔网络中支持多命运细胞决策（即所有“单高态”共存）的基因调控网络结构条件。
summary.methods: 在单调布尔（MB）模型框架下分析互抑制网络，比较不同拓扑对单高态普遍性、等势性及多稳态的支撑能力。
summary.relevance: 直接关涉GRN/Regulon主题，讨论基因调控网络拓扑如何编码细胞命运分化的多稳态设计原则。
summary.caveat: 摘要为纯理论/模型分析，未提供实验验证，结论限于单调布尔模型假设，未必直接适用于真实生物网络。

papers.title: RadarDINO: Distilling a Visual Foundation Model into mmWave Radar for Human Mesh Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar offers a privacy-preserving and illumination-robust alternative for human mesh reconstruction (HMR). However, high-fidelity radar HMR remains challenging. Sparse point cloud-based methods suffer from information loss and missed detections, while raw radar tensor methods like RT-Mesh lack fine-grained semantics and explicit local body modeling. In this paper, we propose RadarDINO, a radar HMR framework that distills visual semantics from a DINOv3 teacher into 3D radar representations and introduces explicit geometric supervision. DINOv3 descriptors are transferred to radar voxels via calibrated RGB-radar geometry, providing voxel- and body-part-level supervision for part-aware radar representations. We further incorporate vertex- and joint-losses to directly constrain reconstructed geometry. On the M4Human dataset, our method outperforms the SOTA baseline across all three evaluation splits.

summary.takeaway: 提出RadarDINO，将DINOv3视觉基础模型的语义知识蒸馏到毫米波雷达三维表征中，用于人体网格重建。
summary.methods: 通过标定的RGB-雷达几何把DINOv3描述子迁移到雷达体素，提供体素级与身体部位级监督，并加入顶点损失与关节损失；在M4Human数据集上评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及预训练与基础模型知识迁移（distillation），与预训练主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在M4Human三个划分上优于SOTA基线，未给出具体数值；跨数据集泛化与真实部署限制未说明。

papers.title: Causal graph fusion across incomplete cohorts and causal steering of tabular foundation models
papers.abstract: Clinical data are split across incomplete cohorts with partially overlapping variables. Causal discovery under missing data and multi-source integration have developed separately, and tabular foundation models cannot take a causal graph without retraining. We make two contributions. First, causal graph fusion learns a partial ancestral graph on the shared variables, fuses it into each cohort's graph under temporal background knowledge and lets Markov blankets guide re-imputation, so missing data are handled inside discovery. Second, causal attention steering compiles the learned graph into the attention of a frozen tabular foundation model at inference. Against known ground truth, fusion dominates pooled and per-cohort baselines in every missingness and heterogeneity condition tested (p<0.001), and steering improves discrimination under distribution shift (p<10^{-5}), a gain that a random graph does not produce. In two spinal cord injury cohorts, fusion orients age, albumin and hemoglobin as ancestors of length of stay, a set no single cohort orients in full, and yields compact, temporally ordered predictor sets that match or exceed automatic feature selection on four of five outcomes.

summary.takeaway: 提出因果图融合与因果注意力引导两方法，使不完整多队列临床数据的因果发现可整合，并无需重训练即可将因果图注入表格基础模型。
summary.methods: 在共享变量上学习部分祖先图，结合时间背景知识融合到各队列图，并以马尔可夫毯指导重插补；将图编译为冻结表格基础模型的推理时注意力引导；用已知真值基准及两个脊髓损伤队列评估。
summary.relevance: 涉及表格基础模型（预训练模型）的推理时适配与因果结构利用，与预训练主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告的显著性结果基于其自设的缺失与异质性条件及真值基准；临床队列结论为关联性结构发现，未证明因果干预效果。

papers.title: Autonomous Particle Image Velocimetry Using Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Particle image velocimetry (PIV) reconstructs a flow field from the motion of tracer particles but the reconstruction quality is bounded by how well the flow structure of interest is resolved in the images.
