The acquisition position is typically fixed by the operator before the measurement. We cast camera placement as a sequential decision-making problem and train a reinforcement learning agent to control a 6-DoF manipulator equipped with a camera, enabling it to locate, frame and resolve a hydrofoil wake in a water tunnel. The agent commands the camera pose and observes the scene only through the velocity field and uncertainty estimated from time-separated image pairs. It is trained entirely in a photorealistic simulation of our water tunnel, with wakes generated by Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) simulations of hydrofoils with varying profiles, positions and angles of attack. After zero-shot transfer to the real water tunnel, the policy reliably locates and frames the wakes of randomly placed hydrofoils. It resolves the wake at a higher resolution than a fixed camera view and with lower error in the measured flow statistics, in roughly half the time of a full scan and with far fewer image pairs.

summary.takeaway: 将PIV相机位姿控制建模为序贯决策问题，用完全在仿真中训练的强化学习智能体实现零样本迁移到真实水洞，自主定位并解析水翼尾流。
summary.methods: 智能体控制6自由度机械臂相机，仅以时间分离图像对估计的速度场和不确定性为观测；训练数据来自CFD生成的不同翼型、位置和攻角尾流的照片级仿真。
summary.relevance: 直接对应强化学习主题，展示sim-to-real零样本迁移。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明在随机放置水翼的尾流定位与统计误差上优于固定视角，未给出定量指标；对未训练流场类型的泛化能力未说明。

papers.title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) approaches have demonstrated strong performance across diverse domains in recent years, learning accurate world models from agent trajectories. However, despite this progress, current approaches still struggle to surpass human performance on tasks that require long-term memory and planning. In this work, we address the problem of long-term memory in MBRL by moving beyond the commonly studied paradigm of architecture design. We introduce Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning (TT-MBRL), using gradient descent at test time to encode the memory of episode observations into world model parameters. This enables the agent to learn a distinct world model for each episode, improving memory capabilities compared to traditional approaches that solely rely on contextual memory. We first establish a proof of concept on a simplified two-dimensional variant of the Memory Maze environment, which we refer to as Memory Maze 2D, showing consistent improvements across different world model architectures. We then demonstrate the effectiveness of TT-MBRL in the 3D domain, achieving new state-of-the-art results on the Memory Maze benchmark. Finally, we show that TT-MBRL maintains strong performance on non-memory benchmarks such as DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.

summary.takeaway: 提出TT-MBRL，在测试时用梯度下降把单回合观测记忆编码进世界模型参数，为每个回合学习独立世界模型以增强长时记忆。
summary.methods: 在简化的Memory Maze 2D上验证，再在3D Memory Maze、DeepMind Control和Atari 100k上评估。
summary.relevance: 与强化学习主题相关，针对基于模型强化学习中的长期记忆与规划问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称取得新的SOTA但未给出具体数值；测试时梯度下降带来的计算开销与实时性限制未讨论。

papers.title: Logit Laundering: Evading Data-Use Auditing in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Data-use auditing in Large Language Models (LLMs) aims to determine whether the given data has been used for training, thereby supporting data ownership safeguards. A dominant solution is data watermarking, which embeds traceable signals into training data and detects them in model outputs. Recent studies have proposed many watermarking-based auditing methods in LLMs. However, systematic investigation from an adversarial perspective remains limited: non-compliant LLM providers would use unauthorized copyrighted datasets for training their own models to enhance model capabilities, while attempting to evade detection by auditors, thereby avoiding legal liability. To fill this research gap, we propose a novel evasion framework, termed Logit Laundering, where the non-compliant LLM provider manipulates model outputs at inference time to undermine detectable watermark signals. Specifically, we design a logit reshaping module to suppress watermark-induced statistical signals by integrating a statistical bias estimator as a plug-and-play component. This design keeps the model parameters unchanged and performs manipulation only in the logit space, thereby enabling auditing evasion while minimizing the impact on model's learned knowledge. To further balance evasion effectiveness and model utility, we introduce a confidence-aware scaling module to adaptively calibrate the suppression strength based on next-token prediction confidence. Extensive evaluations show that Logit Laundering can successfully evade existing various state-of-the-art auditing methods, significantly attenuating detectable signals, while preserving model utility on downstream tasks. Our work highlights the need for exploring more robust auditing methods to guard against evasion behaviors.

summary.takeaway: 提出Logit Laundering规避框架，通过在推理时重塑logit抑制水印统计信号，从而逃避LLM数据使用审计同时尽量保持模型效用。
summary.methods: 设计logit重塑模块，集成即插即用的统计偏差估计器，仅改动logit空间而不改参数；并引入置信度感知缩放模块按下一词预测置信度自适应调节抑制强度；对多种审计方法进行评估。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型主题相关，涉及LLM数据溯源与水印审计的对抗性问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要称在多种SOTA审计方法上成功规避并保持下游效用，但未给出具体指标；该框架为对抗性方法，其结论依赖所测试的审计方法集合。

papers.title: Mapping the regulatory wiring of endothelial cell differentiation reveals a critical role for Hippo mechanosignaling
papers.abstract: At each step of development, stem cells encounter a branching decision to differentiate into one type of cell or another. This decision is executed through the action of competing gene programs that specify different cellular identities. Consequently, creating a comprehensive map of the gene programs that drive each branching step of human cell differentiation remains a long-sought goal of developmental and stem cell biology. Here, we introduce a framework combining genome-wide CRISPR screens, single-cell readouts, and gene program inference to systematically discover and characterize regulators of cell differentiation. This framework includes a method for CRISPR perturbations paired with single-cell RNA-seq called circular capture Perturb-seq (CC-Perturb-seq), which improves gRNA detection from split-pool combinatorial indexing protocols and enables perturbing many candidate regulators to map their effects on gene programs. We applied this framework to map how human pluripotent stem cells differentiate into arterial endothelial cells (ECs), and identified 174 regulators that promote or inhibit EC differentiation. By tracking gene programs across three stages of differentiation, we resolved when and how regulators divert cells toward alternative fates. This map revealed an unexpected requirement for the Hippo mechanosignaling pathway in EC specification. During lateral mesoderm differentiation, Hippo mechanosignaling was required to activate ETV2, the master transcriptional regulator of endothelial identity. Inhibiting Hippo blocked ETV2 even in the presence of VEGF and diverted progenitors to a mesenchymal fate in vitro. Likewise, Hippo signaling was required for maximal etv2 expression in developing zebrafish embryos. Conversely, pharmacologically activating the Hippo pathway increased the purity of both arterial and venous EC differentiation in vitro. Our framework thus identifies novel regulators of endothelial cell differentiation, improves stem-cell differentiation protocols via manipulation of mechanosignaling, and provides a generalizable platform for mapping the regulatory wiring of human development.

summary.takeaway: 构建结合全基因组CRISPR筛选、单细胞读出与基因程序推断的框架，绘制人干细胞向动脉内皮细胞分化的调控图谱，并发现Hippo机械信号通路的关键作用。
summary.methods: 开发circular capture Perturb-seq（CC-Perturb-seq）以改进split-pool组合索引的gRNA检测；鉴定174个促/抑内皮分化调控因子，追踪三个分化阶段的基因程序；并在斑马鱼胚胎与药理激活实验中验证Hippo作用。
summary.relevance: 与单细胞扰动主题直接相关，属于CRISPR扰动结合单细胞RNA-seq的调控网络解析。
summary.caveat: 摘要聚焦内皮分化单一谱系，框架在其他细胞类型中的可推广性尚待验证；机制结论主要来自体外与斑马鱼模型。

papers.title: FeatureMAP enables network-guided interpretation of untargeted metabolomics
papers.abstract: Untargeted liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) metabolomics generates thousands of features, but incomplete metabolite annotation and reliance on predefined pathways limit their biological interpretation. Here we present FeatureMAP, an LC-MS feature-centric computational framework that integrates multi-evidence metabolite annotation, network-guided refinement, metabolic module discovery, and structured large language model-based functional interpretation. Across ten public datasets, FeatureMAP improved MS1-based metabolite candidate prioritization while reducing annotation redundancy. In semi-synthetic benchmarks, FeatureMAP recovered coordinated metabolic perturbations, achieving 92% recovery of a simulated perturbation, and distinguished concurrent metabolic processes. Controlled benchmarks further evaluated functional interpretation under competing metabolite-level signals. Based on FeatureMAP, we additionally developed PhenoMAP, a phenotype-aware knowledge graph comprising 12,929 dysregulated metabolic modules from 501 human metabolomics studies spanning 326 phenotypes. Module-level comparisons revealed reproducible metabolic similarities across independent studies and biologically supported relationships among phenotypes. Application to Alzheimer's disease cerebrospinal fluid and cellular datasets identified convergent membrane-lipid alterations and implicated galactose-linked glycosphingolipid remodeling. Together, FeatureMAP and PhenoMAP enable network-grounded interpretation of incompletely annotated LC-MS metabolomics data and systematic investigation of metabolic dysregulation across biological conditions.

summary.takeaway: 提出FeatureMAP，一个以LC-MS特征为中心的计算框架，整合多证据代谢物注释、网络引导精炼、代谢模块发现与基于大语言模型的功能解读，并构建PhenoMAP知识图谱。
summary.methods: 整合多证据注释与网络引导精炼，在半合成基准中评估扰动回收，并在十个公共数据集上评估注释优先级；构建含501项研究、326种表型、12,929个失调代谢模块的PhenoMAP，应用于阿尔茨海默病脑脊液与细胞数据。
summary.relevance: 同时关涉大语言模型功能解读与知识图谱构建两个主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未详述LLM解读的准确性评估方式；代谢物注释不完整仍是基础限制，PhenoMAP的覆盖范围受所收录研究限制。

papers.title: Against All Likelihood
papers.abstract: Maximum likelihood is the dominant training principle for large language models, yet likelihood is neither necessary nor sufficient for truth. Unlikely events happen every day, and frequently repeated statements can be false. Drawing on a philosophical tradition that ties objectivity to invariance rather than probability (from Nozick's account of objective facts and Wigner's principles of invariance to the structural realism of Poincaré and Cassirer), we argue that the truth of a statement should be judged not by its probability under a single distribution, but by its invariance across relevant transformations of the environment. We connect this view to machine learning literature on out-of-distribution generalization and invariant learning, sketch how invariance could be tested at inference time with language models, and discuss implications for continual learning.

summary.takeaway: 该文提出应以陈述在环境相关变换下的不变性而非单一分布下的概率来判断其真实性，并论证最大似然既非真理的必要条件也非充分条件。
summary.methods: 属于立场/观点论文，借鉴哲学传统（Nozick、Wigner、Poincaré、Cassirer 的结构实在论）进行论证，并联系机器学习中的分布外泛化与不变性学习文献，提出可在推理时用语言模型检验不变性的设想。
summary.relevance: 直接针对大语言模型以最大似然为核心的训练原则提出质疑，属于大语言模型训练目标层面的讨论；其关于不变性与持续学习的讨论同持续学习主题相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出论证思路与设想，未报告任何实验、数据或定量结果；推理时如何具体检验不变性、以及在持续学习中的实际效果均未在摘要中说明。
